description: Trip Composer policy. Config, never code. The composer judges COMPLETE trips: a mediocre hotel deal can form an exceptional trip with an exceptional flight and vice versa — but ordinary × ordinary must stay silent, and an absurdly overpriced component must be able to kill a trip regardless of its partner.

travellers.adultsNote: Trip costs are for the whole party: airfare × adults + one room. Matches the stay radar's 2-adult observation posture.

matching.maxArrivalLeadNote: A flight departing up to this many days before check-in counts as compatible (long-haul overnight arrivals land next day). Departure on the check-in date itself is compatible only for same-day-arrival routes — we cannot see arrival times reliably, so the buffer is conservative and the exact dates are always shown. Nothing is ever manufactured: only stored flight dates match stored stay windows.
matching.maxFlightAgeNote: A flight observation older than this is a memory, not an offer — excluded from composition.
matching.ceilingNote: Hard combination ceilings: the composer starts from strong components and joins plausible neighbours; it never Cartesian-products the tables. Every ceiling that bites is reported.

admission.description: Gates INTO scoring. Components below their standalone candidate thresholds are deliberately admissible — the trip is the unit of judgement — but at least one of these gates must pass. Quality inputs are 0..1.

scoring.weightsNote: NOT an average of flight and stay scores: the strongest component carries twice the weaker one, so one exceptional side can carry a reasonable partner, while tripAbsolute rewards the complete vacation being objectively cheap. Uncomputable components drop and renormalise; computed zeros keep their weight (flight-radar doctrine).

complexityPenalties.penaltyNote: Subtracted from the assembled score (×100), never a component — a penalty cannot be outvoted by a discount.

overpricedKill.note: A component priced at or above this multiple of its OWN comparable median is absurd for a deal radar; the trip is capped here and marked COMPONENT_OVERPRICED regardless of how good the partner is. No median on record = no kill (unknown is not absurd).

scoring.flightQualityNote: Flight quality (0..1) = the flight candidate's stored score/100 where the anomaly engine judged it, else the flight ABSOLUTE rules ramp (config/anomaly.json), else 0 — with 'reasonable' meaning sane and within sanity bounds, not scored.

absolute.description: Trip-class bars: is the COMPLETE vacation objectively cheap? Judged as all-known-cash-per-night for the whole party ((airfare × adults + stay total) / nights), single-currency only — mixed-currency trips are uncomputable here, never converted. Award trips are judged on their CASH portion only, with the miles shown beside it; a cash bar cannot price miles. Bars derived conservatively 2026-08-28 from the radar's own observations (Lily ~$833-1000/nt AI verified + typical VIE⇄MLE fares) and set BELOW plausible normals so ordinary vacations cannot fire them.
absolute.historyNote: trip_opportunities rows are the future trip-baseline substrate. v1 does NOT judge from that history — there is none — and when a later phase does, it must use the same no-look-ahead discipline as every other baseline in this repo.
